title: B.44/07: Review of the independent Technical Advisory Panel
text:
B.44/07: Review of the independent Technical Advisory Panel
The Board, having considered document GCF/B.44/13 titled “Review of the independent Technical Advisory Panel”:
Takes note
of the final report on the Review of the independent Technical Advisory Panel, the Secretariat response, and the independent Technical Advisory Panel responses as contained in document GCF/B.44/13;
Also takes
note of the recommendation by the Investment Committee; and
Requests
the Investment Committee to conduct further analysis on the basis of option 1 of the possible reform independent Technical Advisory Panel packages and findings in the review report as contained in annex II of document GCF/B.44/13 and to inform the Board of its progress at the forty-fifth meeting of the Board.
